architectural_observations: Existing deterministic construction and validation contracts handled repository-level evidence objects without widening scope.
Rejected objects were preserved for analysis without promotion.
No new architecture was required during Campaign 0 execution.
candidate_improvements_discovered: Future campaigns would benefit from a production-specific maturity vocabulary that does not reuse pre-production wording in construction internals.
Duplicate detection is currently campaign-local and fingerprint-based; this was sufficient for Campaign 0 but may need a governed registry after repeated production pressure.
